name: Greta
source:
The only doctor on the island, Greta's red hair makes her stand out from all other inhabitants. She is the one to recognize Chester's disease, and provides him with a temporary place to live, as well as information about the island. Her mannerism makes her seem a lot older than she looks. 

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/enigma/]Fruitbat Factory[/url]]
